title: Continuous compactly supported functions are uniform limits of C¹ functions supported in one fixed compact set (mollification)
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∃ (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (φ : ℕ → Euclidean N → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ y ∉ K, g y = 0) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ y ∉ K, φ k y = 0) ∧ (∀ ε > 0, ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ y, |φ k y - g y| ≤ ε)
